newsitem.title: USA: American Int'l appeals Golden Eagle case.
newsitem.headline: American Int'l appeals Golden Eagle case.

text.p: American International Group Inc said it has filed a notice of appeal in the California Court of Appeal, the first step in its planned challenge of a lower court's decision to award Golden Eagle Insurance Co to another insurer.
A California Superior Court judge on May 30 awarded California workers' compensation insurer Golden Eagle to Boston-based Liberty Mutual Group.
However, the California Insurance Department had previously declared American International the winner of a sealed bid auction for Golden Eagle.
The insurance department then executed a definitive agreement with American International on the details of the rehabilitation plan.
The insurance department in late January seized Golden Eagle because of allegations of a reserve shortfall.
"The court's decision is unsupportable as a matter of law and fairness, and we intend to pursue our rights vigorously," American International executive vice president Robert Sandler said.
